rule.name: WorkBeforeEarlyExit
rule.message: This local is worked out before the early exit on the next line, which leaves without reading it, so every pass that takes the exit pays for the call and throws the result away. Move the declaration below the exit; keep it here only if its exception must be raised on that path too.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $verbs := '^_*(accept|acquire|add|advance|append|apply|call|clear|close|consume|create|dec|decrement|delete|dequeue|eat|emit|enqueue|exec|expect|fetch|generate|inc|increment|insert|lex|match|next|now|open|poll|pop|post|push|put|random|read|release|remove|reset|run|save|scan|send|set|shift|skip|splice|start|stop|take|test|unshift|update|uuid|write|check|require|validate|assert|ensure|verify|invoke|parse|decode|deserialize|load|lock|await|wait|sleep)([A-Z_$0-9]|$)', $settled := function($node) { empty($node/descendant-or-self::*[self::MethodCall or self::ConstructorCall or self::AssignmentExpression or self::UnaryExpression[@Operator = ('++', '--')] or self::LambdaExpression or self::MethodReference]) }, $costly := function($call) { $call/ArgumentList/@Size > 0 and matches($call/@MethodName, '^(resolve|find|lookup|search|locate|compute|calculate|derive|infer|evaluate|analy[sz]e|collect|query|render|normalize|canonicali[sz]e|digest|describe|typeOf)([A-Z_0-9]|$)') and $settled($call/ArgumentList) and $settled($call/*[1][not(self::ArgumentList)]) }, $inMemory := function($init) { (exists($init/self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('toList', 'collect', 'count', 'anyMatch', 'allMatch', 'noneMatch', 'toArray', 'sum', 'max', 'min', 'reduce')][*[1]/descendant-or-self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('stream', 'parallelStream')]]) or exists($init/self::ConstructorCall[ClassType/@SimpleName = ('ArrayList', 'HashMap', 'HashSet', 'LinkedHashMap', 'LinkedHashSet', 'TreeMap', 'TreeSet')][ArgumentList/@Size = 1] [ArgumentList/*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]]) or exists($init/self::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'copyOf'][ArgumentList/@Size = 1] [*[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]])) and empty($init//MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, $verbs)] | $init//AssignmentExpression | $init//UnaryExpression[@Operator = ('++', '--')]) }, $cheapTest := function($test) { empty($test/descendant-or-self::*[self::ConstructorCall or self::AssignmentExpression or self::UnaryExpression[@Operator = ('++', '--')] or self::LambdaExpression or self::MethodReference or self::MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, $verbs)]]) }, $repeated := function($node) { let $scope := $node/ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::LambdaExpression][1] return exists($node/ancestor::*[self::ForeachStatement or self::ForStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement] [ancestor::* intersect $scope]) or exists($scope[self::LambdaExpression][parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('forEach', 'forEachOrdered', 'forEachRemaining', 'map', 'flatMap', 'filter', 'peek', 'anyMatch', 'allMatch', 'noneMatch', 'mapToObj', 'mapToInt', 'mapToLong')][*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.stream.BaseStream') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Iterator')]]]) or exists($scope[self::MethodDeclaration][matches(@Name, '^visit')]) } return //LocalVariableDeclaration[parent::Block][count(VariableDeclarator) = 1] [let $name := VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, $init := VariableDeclarator/*[2], $looping := $repeated(.) return ($inMemory($init) or ($looping and exists($init[self::MethodCall][$costly(.)]))) and exists(following-sibling::*[1][self::IfStatement][count(*) = 2] [*[2]/(self::Block/*[last()] | self::*[not(self::Block)]) [self::BreakStatement or self::ContinueStatement or self::ReturnStatement or self::ThrowStatement]] [empty(.//VariableAccess[@Name = $name])] [empty(*[1]/descendant-or-self::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('==', '!=')][NullLiteral]/VariableAccess [@Name = $init/descendant-or-self::VariableAccess/@Name])] [$settled(*[1]) or ($cheapTest(*[1]) and $looping)])]
